page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Full-width ornamental frieze at the top, then the title block (work title, "DE", "LIBERTATE."), then a large-initial opening paragraph, a decorative band, the chapter heading "CAPVT PRIMVM." with an italic subtitle, and a final paragraph. Page number top right. Small marginal numbers at the left of the first and third lines of the chapter paragraph. No running head, catchword or signature.

main_text.head: DISPVTATIO DE LIBERTATE.
main_text.p: 1.MVLTI, tum Philosophi Ethnici, tum Theologi Christiani, de libertate liberè philosophati sunt. Quamvis autem ex variis & contrariis eorum scriptis, huic doctrinæ enodandæ non patrùm luminisaffulisse existimem: Plurima tamen posteris inquirenda, & diligentiùs examinanda eos reliquisse non dubito. Quamobrem ergo vestigiis eorum insistens, & aliquando ab iis deflectens; aliquid novi in hac materia tradere, aut jam traditum clariùs explicare proposui; ut quid de ea sentiendum sit, tutò ac facilius dignoscatur. Primò, autem agam de actionibus quarum cognitio necessaria est ad intelligentiam libertatis. Secundò, de libertate in genere. Tertiò, de libertate Dei. Quartò, de libertate creaturæ intelligentis, ac potissimùm hominis, in genere. Quintò, de libertate hominis in quolibet statu.
main_text.head: CAPVT PRIMVM.

head.i: De Actionibus Quarum Cognitio Necessaria est ad Intelligentiam Libertatis.

main_text.p: 2.ACtiones quarum cognitio necessaria est ad intelligentiam libertatis sunt. 1. Naturalis & violenta. 2. Spontanea & coacta. 3.3. Voluntaria & involuntaria. 4. Libera & necessaria. De quibus quanta fieri poterit brevitate & claritate tractabimus, incipientes à naturali.

page.notes: Ornamental friezes and the decorated initials M and A are not text. The large initials are joined to their words as printed ("ACtiones"). The marginal numbers "1.", "2." and "3." are section numbers in the margin; the "3." beside the line "3. Voluntaria" may be the printed marginal number or the in-text enumeration, so I placed it as a note and kept the in-text "3." as printed. The printed run-on "luminisaffulisse" is a printing error, left as printed. Digitiser watermark at the bottom right excluded.
